steps.content:
June 22, N.F. 115

Outskirts of Fraser City, Farlands

A sand ship glides smoothly across the endless dunes. The WhiteSands lie unusually still, calm but for the faintest whisper of wind. By the window, a lone figure reclines, watching the serene expanse with contentment.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Brilliant sunshine, gentle breeze... Funny how even these endless, monotonous sands can look almost beautiful—when you're not on the job.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Ah, why do happy little vacations always vanish so fast?

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Oh, what's with the gloomy looks? Take in the scenery while you can. You won't see this much beautiful sand once we're back in Fraser.
No one responds, not a single soul. The passengers sit in silent complicity, united in their refusal to acknowledge the voice buzzing in their ears.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Seriously, do we really have to share a ship with her all the way to Fraser?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...We've only got two hours left on this trip. Just bear with it a little longer.
That voice nags at her ear again. Hella turns her gaze toward the source—

Synex, Campbell Shadow Operative Appearance and allegiance unknown, Synex seems to delight in chaos and disruption. Once acting as Fraser's enforcer in Furor, she forced its people to transport Aurum Secretum through storms, yet when the time came, she stayed behind to help defeat the Apostle of Ashes.
Hella isn't sure if she's still an enemy, but...

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: So you're Hella? I thought you were just some fragile dummy, but you've got more wits than I gave you credit for. Strays are always welcome at my place, and I treat my pets very well. Consider the offer, will ya?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Aaahhhh! Gross! She's totally grossing me out!

Another wave of irritation prickles up Hella's spine as she glares at Synex, her gaze sharp enough to scorch through steel. Synex, utterly unfazed, just leans closer to Hypatia, her smirk lazy with indifference.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Hypa? My lady? Oh great Lady Hypatia? It's been so long since we saw each other! Come now, won't you spare a moment for little old me?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Silence. Another word, and I'll have you tossed overboard.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Ohhh, boo-hoo. I knew it. You've tossed aside your poor old friend for some shiny new toys. My heart's absolutely shattered...

Synex clutches her chest in a theatric flourish, her wounded expression collapsing into melodrama as she sinks to the ground. Hella shoots a glance at Hypatia—who, predictably, responds with nothing more than a weary sigh.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Just two more hours. C'mon, I got this! Push through and it'll all be over!
The vessel cuts across the desert, skimming over smooth sand and kicking up plumes of dust in its wake. Inside, its passengers continue their bickering as they race northwest.
As for what caused all this farce...
[Flashback: Before Departure, Underground Furor - Post-Battle]

Inside Furor, Farlands

24 Hours Ago

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: So what's the deal? Any chance you can fix that thing up there?
Hypatia shakes her head. Above her, the barrier that once shielded Furor's skies has dwindled to a handful of flickering points—the last remnants still clinging to life.
The town lies in ruins after the battle. The rock caves that once served as dwellings have collapsed, and the infrastructure is now little more than unrecognizable wreckage.

The Fraser delegation has already departed, and gone is Synex as well—her whereabouts now a mystery. Under Hypatia's direction, the people have cleared a space in the devastation, but they can't stay much longer.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ugh, we worked our butts off to take down that Apostle, and now we just have to leave? That's so unfair...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: It's okay. Our situation now is far better than we initially expected.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: The storms, the disasters, the Apostle of Ashes... any one of them would have been beyond my strength to face alone. Hella, it was only because of you and your companions that the people of Furor survived unharmed.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: A town can always be rebuilt. As long as its people endure, hope will never die.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Thank you. You not only saved my life, but the lives of everyone in Furor as well. I'm truly in your debt.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Whoa, why so serious?! You're totally making me blush here...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: A-anyway! So, uh... got any idea where you're going next?
Hella catches the flicker of hesitation in Hypatia's expression.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...Our first priority must be securing proper medical facilities. Many of the wounded are suffering from infected injuries exacerbated by Mania. With Furor's medical infrastructure compromised, Fraser appears to be our most viable option.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: My brother and the delegation have already departed. While he did arrange an escort for our return, I...
Hypatia pauses, and a chill runs down Hella's spine.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Wait, don't tell me the person you're talking about is—

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Yoo-hoo! Did you miss me, little Hella?
A sudden force crashes into Hella from behind as someone hooks an arm around her neck, their full weight leaning into her.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: That's right, darling. Yours truly gets the honor of escorting the lady and all the Furor folks back to Fraser, and... delivering a special little package along the way.
Synex raises her hand, pointing into the distance. The others turn as one, their gazes locking onto—
—An Apostle. The monstrous figure writhes inside a colossal cage forged from Aurum Secretum, its breaths shallow and ragged.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...What? That Apostle's still kicking?!

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Oh yes, I had to rough it up just enough to keep it breathing. Such a hassle, honestly.
Horo yanks Hella protectively behind her, her gaze sharp with suspicion, while Synex spreads her hands in a mock display of innocence.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: That thing is dangerous... What are you going to do with it this time?

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Ha, I know that look—"These bad guys must be up to no good," am I right? But take a real good look, darling. I'm the one mopping up your little disaster.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Do you see those things on its body?
Hella follows the line of her pointed finger. The Apostle crouches at the base of the cage, its body a tapestry of wounds, utterly immobilized by the Aurum Secretum shackles.
Around its faintly heaving body, countless black particles drift—flecks of darkness that glimmer like distant stars when touched by the light.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: That's Aurum Secretum.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: To be precise, that's raw, unprocessed Aurum Secretum. This semi-physical, semi-spiritual material originates from the Apostle around Furor. It's unstable, but has excellent natural resonance properties.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Of course, you can't just scoop it up and call it a day. Gotta extract it properly from the Apostles, process and refine it... then it becomes the real deal.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: And guess what? Your Furor friends cut a deal with Fraser. Food and shelter in exchange for helping the institute gather fragments and mine Aurum Secretum like good little laborers.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...! So Furor isn't just an experiment site, but a massive mine too?!
Faced with the accusation, Synex shrugs with feigned resignation.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Oh yes. Since the miners aren't working anymore, we can't just leave the lovely mine unattended. Might as well take everything back with us.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: The Apostles are the source of Aurum Secretum and the key to advancing Aurum Secretum technology. Catching one alive is certainly the crown jewel of this whole operation.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: As for you two...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...What are you plotting this time?!

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Ohhh, such distrust! But I promise you, this one's gonna be wonderful.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: My dearest master, Adelaide Campbell, extends his most cordial invitation to our esteemed guests from DisCity. After all your contribution to Furor, he'd love to show you <color=#fb9259>the final results of this Aurum Secretum experiment</color> in Fraser.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Well? Would you two like to come with us?

Outskirts of Fraser City, Farlands

Present
Hella stomps back to her seat, cheeks puffed, and plops down beside Horo.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Where's that horned woman?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: After Hypatia blew her off, that freak started talking about going fishing, and then she actually jumped off the ship! And she took my binoculars! The ones I brought all the way from DisCity!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ugh, I never should've agreed to come with her! Horo, there's gotta be another way to keep investigating, right?

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: No. Putting that woman aside, this is a good opportunity.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Fraser's a major city with tight security. Going in officially under their invitation is our smoothest path in—better than gambling on some backdoor route.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Besides...

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: I found something underground, and this is a good chance to consult the expert.

The Furor disaster buried the trail of the inheritance photo, along with any hope of tracing its sender. Whatever secrets lay underground are now entombed in rubble, leaving the investigation stranded. Without a new lead, the truth might never surface.

Horo didn't find the inheritance, but she uncovered something else there: a brief transcript of Aurum Secretum experiment logs. Fraser, Aurum Secretum, Apostles of Ashes... Are the secrets underground tied to the inheritance? She can't be sure, but the transcript points her toward a new path.
Perhaps... <color=#fb9259>they</color> would know what this photo holds.
"Project Leaders: <color=#fb9259>Hypatia Campbell</color>, <color=#fb9259>Adelaide Campbell</color>"
Horo's gaze lifts to the poised Campbell noble sitting across from her.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: We've been through life and death together. If Hella calls you a friend, then I'll trust you, for now.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Campbell, do you know what this is?
[Image of Inheritance]

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: So you do recognize it.
Hypatia's fingers dart out, pressing the photograph down. Her gaze sweeps the cabin—with Synex gone, only the three of them remain. Only after confirming they're truly alone does she finally speak.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...Hide this photograph, or better yet, burn it. Let no one else lay eyes on it. What it reveals is far too dangerous... mere knowledge of it could get you killed.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: How... did this come into your possession?

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: We recovered it recently from the wreckage of a WhiteSands merchant caravan. No survivors, just debris and corpses scattered around. The photo was sealed inside an envelope, hidden among the cargo.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I see... Then Sibilla must have already...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Sibilla?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Before you, a Furorian also came to me with this photo.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...At the time, I felt only shame—shame that I could do nothing to help her. The experiment was decreed by the Senate, the collective will of our city. All I could do was let her go... and pray she would successfully voice the truth.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: But now that the photograph is in your hands, she must have already...
Silence settles over the cabin. Everyone knows the dangers of WhiteSands. How long could an unequipped refugee possibly last?
Hypatia shakes her head, as if dispelling distractions, or perhaps solidifying a decision.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: What I'm about to tell you... I've never spoken of this to anyone. But you're right. I do know what it is.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Before I took charge of Furor, the researchers stationed there were conducting projects related to it. I can confirm it was physically present within Furor, and the experimental data it left behind is nothing short of horrifying.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: It was far too dangerous. I tried to delve deeper myself, but...
Hypatia pulls up a report on her terminal and points to one of the lines.

[Test Sample IV-001] - ████ ███████. ██████████████. ██████████. Aurum Secretum was devoured by the sample during the experiment. Sample activation proved extremely dangerous. Further operation forbidden.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I eventually abandoned the project. Instead, I petitioned to redirect our research toward developing a resonant mesh defense system—what you now know as the Fraser Kardas.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: The Senate approved my proposal. They withdrew all materials and personnel connected to it from Furor, relocating everything back to Fraser.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: However, I've still caught traces of it in some reports afterward. I suspect the research continued at headquarters, but that... is speculation beyond even my clearance.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Wait, so you're telling me Fraser's been researching the inheritance this whole time?! Then that means...
Hella and Horo exchange glances, both their expressions equally grim.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: The inheritance isn't just about Aurum Secretum; it's also the key to <color=#fb9259>detonating the Black Ring</color>...

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Those Fraser people have probably been working with those Underground rats from the start.
Hypatia takes a deep breath, her body trembling slightly.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: So it is true... My suspicions weren't just paranoia after all...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: While reviewing Black Ring documents related to DisCity, I came across some data-based inferences. I once had my suspicions about the physical form of the "inheritance," but never found definitive proof.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: This goes far beyond what any small team should confront. Wherever it's kept will be protected by layers of danger even I can't anticipate. Hella... are you absolutely certain you want to keep pursuing this?
Silence falls once again. After a moment, Hella begins to speak.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Honestly, all this talk about danger and whether we should keep going is making my head spin. But here's what I know—

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Those jerks behind it have already hurt loads of people in Syndicate, and they'll mess up even more people out there unless someone stops them! Every time this stupid thing appears? Nothing but trouble follows it!

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Someone has to stop them. The Legion didn't leave the city just to turn away now. We face threats head-on. That's who we are.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...Very well.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Then please allow me to join you.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: You're from DisCity, after all. You'll face considerable limitations navigating Fraser's circles. My presence could provide access where yours cannot.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: This city raised me. I cherish it deeply. But... some lines cannot be crossed, and I will not stand by again while others come to harm.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hehe, no sweat! We're basically pros at handling this by now. Consider it already fixed!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Besides...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: We're already in this deep. Can't exactly bail out now, right?
Boom!!

As if in answer to Hella's words, a massive force slams into the ship, hurling everyone aboard violently. Passengers stagger through the cabin, struggling to stay upright. Hella braces herself against the wall before gripping the window frame to peer outside.
[Synex's Portrait]

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Yoo-hoo, little Hella— Come out! I've hooked a big fish—
A horde of sand beasts surges toward the port side. At their forefront—a lone figure, sprinting just ahead of the onslaught. And she's grinning up at Hella with wild, exhilarated eyes.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: "Fish"? You call these ******* "fish"????

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Oh, just some little bugs to get the blood flowing.

Synex skids to a halt and spins toward the creatures, launching herself straight at the lead beast. In one fluid motion, she flips onto its back, seizes its jagged horns, and with a vicious twist, tears them clean off.
The beast's agonized howl splits the air, drowned out only by Synex's ringing laughter, brighter and fiercer than before.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Since I'm heading home anyway, might as well bring back a few trophies!
